observationPattern: harsh overhead light plus weak low-light layering
means: The room may still be broadcasting alertness after dark.
userTranslation: It can feel like the room never fully tells your body to slow down.

observationPattern: large bare wall or unresolved empty area
means: The room may feel clean but not yet settled.
userTranslation: It can feel like one part of the room is still hanging open.

observationPattern: hard surfaces dominate and soft layers are scarce
means: The room may support function more than comfort.
userTranslation: It can feel usable, but not especially held or softened.

observationPattern: too many competing zones or overlapping functions
means: The room may ask attention to split before it can settle.
userTranslation: It can feel like the room wants more than one thing from you at once.
